notes.title: 20220309 Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* New mission - Harbor!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/7f6805c262268e5f65012eb5bc4253698d532acc.png

* You can play  in Top down mode now for better clarity in combat!
Use C key or Middle mouse button to change camera
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/a01c1c3a6587dc789cef61c6ea95922de209e20e.png

* New better and more intuitive controls
* Graphics changes for top down view
* Post process update
* Lightmap reworked in all missions
* Mission 10 - Bomb explode after 15 turns
* 3D view camera can be rotated every 45 degrees
* New control scheme:

SWAD - move camera
QE - rotate camera
C - change camera view
Left mouse button - actions with units, action selection
Right mouse button - change unit view
Middle mouse button - change camera 3D View/Top Down

Top down view: 
Mouse wheel: camera zoom
3D view: 
Mouse wheel: camera rotation +- 45 degrees

notes.title: 20220116 Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/6013a72c49d8f9c5f7511a18f590a8d31e375255.png

Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* Engine update
* You can rotate view with Q,E keys
* Overwatch bug solved
* Flashbang blinds the enemy for one turn and decrease morale. After 1 turn, enemy can do action again.
If is morale of enemy too low, he can surrender.
* Added new GUI messages - Enemy blinded and Gave himself up!
* When enemy hear noise behind doors, he can aim to doors on end of turn.
* Several textures updated
* Bug with pistol's sound fixed
* Lightmap bug in mission 4 was fixed
* Bug with collisions in mission 3 fixed
* Several animation glitches on units fixed
* Ai reaction on sounds changed

notes.title: 20211208 Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/45e90f697960e5cf611a93a61fa6761cf838feb9.png

Dear players!
New mission - Bomb in warehouse is here! You can play it, if you have completed mission 9.

About mission:
A report of a bomb threat in a small warehouse building. The bomb is likely to go off within the next 10 minutes (turns)

* Sound bug when mission start fixed
* Ai slight update
* Graphics bug in mission 9 fixed
* Units can defuse the bomb now with multifunctional tool
* Several small bugs fixed in UI

notes.title: 20211106 Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/af9449e10b7d96943d8e33772b5e79f79e521f2c.jpg

Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* Big speed improvement in AI calculations during enemy turn. 
It spend lower than half of previous time.

* You can use spy camera tool on corners of walls
* You can switch between units with TAB key
* You can select  units with 1-5 alpha keys
* You can use G key to throw grenade

* Bug when unit rotates after clicking on menu or end turn was fixed
* Fixed bug when unit rotates to enemy after click on him
* Action selector GUI bug fixed when sometimes run unwanted actions if you move mouse away and click

* Fixed bug in spy camera - camera was incorrect sometimes
* Changed optiwand camera for better view of situation
* Fixed bug in level 3 - an enemy sometimes walked through walls in a cottage
* Slight reworked Level 3, added more paths and several obstacles removed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/2a00aafa99e98fd93ac6737452f76260c0b22599.jpg

notes.title: 20211019 Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/6900d5d932bc09d03011c4eca57f476d91511721.jpg

Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* Welcome achievement bug fixed
* Changes in game interface. You can click on suspects and select weapon fire actions directly
* Units have more actions points - new default value is 10. You can do more actions during turn.
If you have skill points more than 40 - action points will increase to 11
If you have skill points more than 70 - action points will increase to 12
* Using explosives on doors have impact to suspects if stand close to the doors -
morale will be decreased, depend on how are distance between suspects and doors
* Fixed bug with map borders
* Better loading time of menu

notes.title: Big graphics update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/49b6d495d5f61197d753fbba4d615e6f5cfc8c19.jpg

Dear players!
We are hard working on game and here are some news:
* The new release date - October 15  
* Better lighting
* New models
* 3D grass
* New trees and bushes 
* New Swat unit's models with animation
* Free camera movement and rotation
* New physics
* Ragdoll physics added.
* New better animations from motion capture will be added soon.
